lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The inter-centroid distance increases significantly moving from the anterior to the mid-flank region, forming a sparse grid of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal rows of spots. The spots are predominantly positioned as nodes at the center of these vertical bands, creating a well-defined rectilinear grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, each exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin, located at the upper left frame boundary, displays a high-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs uniformly distributed across its surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit exhibits a markedly higher density of significantly smaller spots compared to the flank. The pectoral fin likewise displays a dense, uniform patterning of small high-luminance blobs.
